fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Divination as a Conversation With Yourself", "body": "Chance sets divination apart from fortune telling, calling it a conversation with yourself, and says whatever he is egoically stuck on never stops turning up in the cards. Rachel describes her practice as a visual conversation with the divine that leads her down pathways she might not have thought of. A second guest from the Telegram group says her morning rune pulls show the theme of the day and what she is not looking at, and that ego or fear driven questions get a different answer than the one asked."}, {"title": "Runes as Glyphs of Nature and Wealth", "body": "Rachel sees the runes as glyphs that grew out of pictographs, patterns of nature that describe growth the way Chance's I Ching hexagrams do. She lays out the Elder Futhark as three sets of eight and opens with a pair of cattle runes: Fehu, the herd you own and work with symbiotically, and Uruz, the wild ox, the free abundance of nature, like the wild kale in her yard. She links those runes to tarot pentacles and Taurus, and shows the set she made herself from bottle caps instead of wood."}, {"title": "A Spiral Hero's Journey Up Yggdrasil", "body": "Asked about a hero's journey, Rachel reads each set of eight as a stage up the world tree Yggdrasil: arrival on earth, Raidho the horse and the journey, a gift that comes with a sacrifice such as an old belief, and finally joy. The three sets move from the foundation of being, to time and cycles, to stepping into your own divinity. She calls it a spiral rather than a circle, since no fall is ever the same fall, and Chance ties it to eternal return and the paradox of freeing your will into the cosmic will."}, {"title": "Isa, Ice and the Present Moment", "body": "Rachel names Isa, the ice rune, as a favourite and draws on the Havamal, attributed to Odin, where ice sits among the things you cannot trust. In her reading ice is the now moment, with only an illusion of stability, so she treats it as a lesson in healthy non-attachment and being okay with mistakes. She places the past with Hel, Loki's daughter, the underworld of ancestors and memory, and describes the whole Norse cosmology as a balance of fire and ice. Chance adds that the present is a narrow band between the two."}, {"title": "Odin, Peter Pan and Growing Up", "body": "Chance says so many people tell him Odin or Hermes visits their dreams that he wonders whether the figure is a mature higher self. Rachel sees such gods as ancient ancestors, says the father archetype is surfacing as an era shifts, and cautions against treating Odin and Hermes as one entity, a point Chance concedes. Chance then reads Peter Pan, since pan means all, as an inverted All Father stuck in eternal childhood, and Rachel adds wolf cults of Odin and the Aries challenge of keeping an inner child alive."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Rachel M is an active member of the InnerVerse telegram group who is involved with divinatory arts like tarot and rune-reading. In this live stream, we'll be introducing the use of the Futhark runes while tangentially touching on other tarot-type topics, and exploring Odin, I Ching, Gene Keys, and more.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: Hour 2 of this podcast is reserved for Rokfin & Patreon members.
